grade_drills_intro: Pick a grade and download the drill you'd like to practice.
grade_drills_disclaimer: Grade placement follows Japan's Course of Study; please also consider your child's understanding.
preset_g1_addsub_desc: Random single-digit addition and subtraction problems.
preset_g1_complement10_desc: Practice number pairs that add up to 10.
preset_g1_hyakumasu_desc: A 100-square addition grid using single-digit numbers.
preset_g1_missing_value_desc: Practice finding the missing number in single-digit addition and subtraction expressions.
preset_g2_kuku_desc: Practice the multiplication table for the number you choose (1-9).
preset_g2_complement100_desc: Practice number pairs that add up to 100.
preset_g2_missing_value_desc: Practice finding the missing number in 2-digit addition and subtraction expressions, e.g. "__ + 5 = 12".
preset_g3_mul_desc: Practice multiplying a 2-digit number by a 1-digit number.
preset_g3_div_desc: Practice dividing a 2-digit number by a 1-digit number.
preset_g3_mul_intermediate_desc: Practice breaking a 2-digit by 1-digit multiplication into tens and ones, shown as an intermediate formula.
preset_g3_missing_value_desc: Practice finding the missing number in multiplication and division expressions, e.g. "12 / 3" shown as "3 x __ = 12".
preset_g3_fraction_desc: Practice common-denominator fraction calculations whose answers remain below one.
preset_g4_mul_desc: Practice multiplying a 3-digit number by a 2-digit number.
preset_g4_div_desc: Practice dividing a 3-digit number by a 2-digit number.
preset_g4_mix_desc: A random mix of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
preset_g4_parentheses_desc: Practice calculating the parenthesized part of an expression first. Mixes all four operations and both parenthesis positions, e.g. (a + b) x c or a - (b x c).
preset_g4_missing_value_desc: Practice finding the missing number in expressions mixing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
preset_g4_fraction_desc: Practice adding and subtracting fractions with the same denominator.
preset_g5_mix_desc: A mix of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, up to 3 digits by 2 digits.
preset_g5_parentheses_advanced_desc: Same mixed-operation, mixed-position practice as grade 4, with a 2-digit first operand.
preset_g5_missing_value_desc: Same mixed-operation missing-number practice as grade 4, centered on 3 digits by 2 digits.
preset_g5_fraction_desc: Practice finding common denominators before adding and subtracting fractions.
preset_g6_mix_desc: A mix of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, up to 3 digits by 3 digits.
preset_g6_parentheses_advanced_desc: Same mixed-operation, mixed-position practice as grade 4, with a 3-digit first operand.
preset_g6_missing_value_desc: Same mixed-operation missing-number practice as grade 4, centered on 3 digits by 3 digits.
preset_g2_addsub_written_desc: Practice adding and subtracting 2-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g2_add_written_desc: Practice adding 2-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g2_sub_written_desc: Practice subtracting 2-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g3_addsub_written_desc: Practice adding and subtracting 3-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g3_add_written_desc: Practice adding 3-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g3_sub_written_desc: Practice subtracting 3-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g3_mul_written_title: Multiplication, Written Format (2 digits x 1 digit)
preset_g3_mul_written_desc: Practice multiplying a 2-digit number by a 1-digit number in written-calculation format.
preset_g4_mul_written_title: Multiplication, Written Format (3 digits x 2 digits)
preset_g4_mul_written_desc: Practice multiplying a 3-digit number by a 2-digit number in written-calculation format.
preset_g4_div_written_desc: Practice dividing a 3-digit number by a 2-digit number using the long-division (written-calculation) format.
preset_g4_addsub_written_desc: Practice adding and subtracting 4-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g4_add_written_desc: Practice adding 4-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g4_sub_written_desc: Practice subtracting 4-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g5_addsub_written_desc: Practice adding and subtracting 5-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g5_add_written_desc: Practice adding 5-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g5_sub_written_desc: Practice subtracting 5-digit numbers in written-calculation format.
preset_g6_addsub_written_title: Addition & Subtraction, Written Format (Mixed Digit Lengths)
preset_g6_addsub_written_desc: Practice adding and subtracting numbers with different digit lengths (e.g. 5 digits and 3 digits) in written-calculation format.
preset_g6_add_written_desc: Practice adding numbers with different digit lengths (e.g. 5 digits and 3 digits) in written-calculation format.
preset_g6_sub_written_desc: Practice subtracting numbers with different digit lengths (e.g. 5 digits and 3 digits) in written-calculation format.
preset_ungraded_abc_desc: Mental-math training using the breakdown of 4-digit numbers (aBc calculation).
preset_ungraded_squ_desc: Practice multiplying a number by itself (square numbers).
examprep_section_desc: Practice problems combining multi-term calculation, parentheses, and mixed operators for middle-school entrance exam preparation.
preset_g4_examprep_basic_1_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 1-digit number and 2 single-digit numbers combined into a 3-term expression using just one of add/sub/mul/div throughout.
preset_g4_examprep_basic_2_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 1-digit number and 3 single-digit numbers combined into a 4-term expression using just one of add/sub/mul/div throughout.
preset_g4_examprep_basic_3_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 1-digit number and 4 single-digit numbers combined into a 5-term expression using just one of add/sub/mul/div throughout.
preset_g4_examprep_intermediate_1_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 1-digit number and 2 single-digit numbers combined into a 3-term expression mixing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
preset_g4_examprep_intermediate_2_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 1-digit number and 3 single-digit numbers combined into a 4-term expression mixing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
preset_g4_examprep_intermediate_3_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 1-digit number and 4 single-digit numbers combined into a 5-term expression mixing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
preset_g4_examprep_advanced_1_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 1-digit number and 2 single-digit numbers combined into a 3-term expression with parentheses and mixed operators, modeling harder entrance-exam application problems.
preset_g4_examprep_advanced_2_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 1-digit number and 3 single-digit numbers combined into a 4-term expression with parentheses and mixed operators, modeling harder entrance-exam application problems.
preset_g4_examprep_advanced_3_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 1-digit number and 4 single-digit numbers combined into a 5-term expression with parentheses and mixed operators, modeling harder entrance-exam application problems.

preset_g5_examprep_basic_2_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 2-digit number and 3 single-digit numbers combined into a 4-term expression using just one of add/sub/mul/div throughout.
preset_g5_examprep_basic_3_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 2-digit number and 4 single-digit numbers combined into a 5-term expression using just one of add/sub/mul/div throughout.
preset_g5_examprep_intermediate_1_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 2-digit number and 2 single-digit numbers combined into a 3-term expression mixing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
preset_g5_examprep_intermediate_2_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 2-digit number and 3 single-digit numbers combined into a 4-term expression mixing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
preset_g5_examprep_intermediate_3_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 2-digit number and 4 single-digit numbers combined into a 5-term expression mixing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
preset_g5_examprep_advanced_1_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 2-digit number and 2 single-digit numbers combined into a 3-term expression with parentheses and mixed operators, modeling harder entrance-exam application problems.
preset_g5_examprep_advanced_2_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 2-digit number and 3 single-digit numbers combined into a 4-term expression with parentheses and mixed operators, modeling harder entrance-exam application problems.
preset_g5_examprep_advanced_3_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 2-digit number and 4 single-digit numbers combined into a 5-term expression with parentheses and mixed operators, modeling harder entrance-exam application problems.

preset_g6_examprep_basic_2_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 3-digit number and 3 single-digit numbers combined into a 4-term expression using just one of add/sub/mul/div throughout.

preset_g6_examprep_intermediate_1_desc: Entrance-exam prep: one 3-digit number and 2 single-digit numbers combined into a 3-term expression mixing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
